subject.title: Feature request: config option to disable restart sentinel notification

question: Should OpenClaw add a public restart-sentinel notification suppression contract, and should that contract be global config, per config/update request, or both?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but the fix would add public config or protocol surface in a stable gateway lifecycle path where repository policy requires intentional API direction.

options.title: Approve Narrow Notify-Only Contract
options.body: Add one explicit opt-out that suppresses only the direct outbound restart notice while preserving wake, system-event, continuation, and routing behavior.

options.title: Prefer Per-Request Silence
options.body: Add a request parameter for config/update callers that own their restart messaging, leaving default user-visible sentinel behavior unchanged.

options.title: Keep Notices Mandatory
options.body: Reject suppression for now, keep restart notices as part of the recovery contract, and close related noise requests with that rationale.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Notify-Only Contract
recommendation.body: Add one explicit opt-out that suppresses only the direct outbound restart notice while preserving wake, system-event, continuation, and routing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the gateway config/update restart flow and is the strongest history signal for the core config/API direction this would change.
